title: Customer outages, April-September 2026
body:
From April 2026 through September 2026, fake sample data records 696 customer outages. Batteries covered 592. 104 customers lost power. This is fake sample data, not a live outage feed.
April 2026 customer outages: 80 customers, battery covered 72, 8 lost power, median duration 41 minutes. Leading cause was a utility grid outage.
May 2026 customer outages: 146 customers, battery covered 121, 25 lost power, median duration 78 minutes. Leading cause was a utility feeder outage during a thunderstorm.
June 2026 customer outages: 94 customers, battery covered 86, 8 lost power, median duration 36 minutes. Leading cause was planned utility maintenance.
July 2026 customer outages: 121 customers, battery covered 103, 18 lost power, median duration 54 minutes. Leading cause was a utility grid outage.
August 2026 customer outages: 188 customers, battery covered 149, 39 lost power, median duration 96 minutes. Leading cause was grid load shed during a heat wave.
September 2026 customer outages: 67 customers, battery covered 61, 6 lost power, median duration 29 minutes. Leading cause was a utility grid outage.

title: Customer outage events, April-September 2026
body:
On 2026-05-12 in Houston, 61 of May 2026's 146 customer outages occurred. Batteries covered 48. 13 customers lost power for a median 110 minutes. Cause: a thunderstorm opened a utility feeder.
On 2026-06-03 in Austin, 14 of June 2026's 94 customer outages occurred. Batteries covered 14. 0 customers lost power for a median 22 minutes. Cause: planned utility maintenance.
On 2026-08-14 in Houston and Dallas, 97 of August 2026's 188 customer outages occurred. Batteries covered 71. 26 customers lost power for a median 140 minutes. Cause: grid load shed during a heat wave, and 9 batteries did not start.
